findings.message: Implemented as a Camunda user task (zeebe:userTask).
Camunda Form "review" linked with zeebe:formDefinition formId.
findings.suggestion: Deploy the .form file with the process; Camunda 7 and 8 share the form-js schema.

findings.message: Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.8.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.

xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:modeler="http://camunda.org/schema/modeler/1.0" xmlns:zeebe="http://camunda.org/schema/zeebe/1.0" id="Definitions_test" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" modeler:executionPlatform="Camunda Cloud" modeler:executionPlatformVersion="8.8.0">
  <bpmn:process id="p" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:userTask id="u">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:userTask/>
        <zeebe:formDefinition formId="review" bindingType="deployment"/>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
    </bpmn:userTask>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
